1.

What depth of eternal riches In God’s knowledge, power, and wisdom, O what love, O what grace! Who can fathom His ways, Who can search out His judgments, Who can comprehend His counsel here?

2.

God in grace has given His Son, He has become a Mediator Between the children of men and God. He on the cross has brought atonement, The Spirit among us has His dwelling, And we raise joyful sounds.

3.

Think, when we have reached the haven, The conflict ended, rest found, And stand forth in snow-white robe! Then to our God we shall bring homage, The Lamb’s new song shall resound Sweetly to golden harps’ sound.

4.

There the eye shall never tear, The heart shall not by sin be wounded Upon the blissful shore of peace, None there by sorrow be moved, No lament of pain be heard, And there death’s hand shall not reach.

5.

Lord, teach us Thy ways, Help us to follow Thy paths, Teach us to bear the cross here, Until we hence to Thee may go, Eternally in Thy home to be, To behold Thee as Thou art!
